contact.faq1Q: How long does it take to issue a Micro Business Permit (IUMK) & NIB?
contact.faq1A: The verification and issuance of NIB through SIPEDI takes place automatically and instantly (within 5-15 minutes) once all required documents are properly uploaded.
contact.faq2Q: Are permit applications and complaints subject to fees?
contact.faq2A: All public services on SIPEDI (both Micro Business Licensing and Public Order Complaints) are 100% FREE and exempt from any illegal fees.
contact.faq3Q: How do I track the status of a submitted public order complaint?
contact.faq3A: You can enter your Receipt Number / Complaint ID in the "Track Status" feature on the Home page or monitor officer progress on your Account Dashboard in real-time.
contact.faq4Q: What should I do if I forget my SIPEDI account password?
contact.faq4A: Click "Login / Register", select the "Forgot Password?" link, and enter your registered email. A password recovery link will be sent directly to your inbox.
